## Goal

Which critical logic should be covered by automated tests?

## Proposal

- [ ] Scoring formula (time factor, precision, streak)
- [ ] Tolerance thresholds per difficulty level
- [ ] API behavior on invalid inputs
- [ ] Audio engine regression smoke tests

## Definition of Done

- [ ] Test cases are documented
- [ ] Reproducible local execution verified
- [ ] Failure scenarios covered
